name: Grave Ground

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Reference entry; bespoke effects require manual resolution. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Reference-only: Arrange up to four contiguous 10-foot squares of skeletal hands within range; enemies treat them as Difficult Terrain. Enemies present at casting, entering, or ending a turn there save Strength once per turn: failure deals 6d6 Necrotic and subtracts 1d6 from damage rolls until their next turn ends. Add 1d6 damage per slot above 5.
